_meta.description: Canonical character → voice id registry. Provider is per-entry ('kling' or 'elevenlabs') — Kling is the primary lip-sync path, ElevenLabs is the fallback used until a Kling voice is cloned for that character (per VIDEO_PRODUCTION_HANDOFF.md §10.5). Each character is LOCKED to one voice_id so the same person sounds identical across every episode, every day, forever. Update only when a voice is intentionally retired and replaced (which should force a regeneration of every render that used the old voice).
_meta.schema: character_id: { provider, voice_id, pitch_shift_semitones, voice_speed, notes, locked_at }
_meta.how_to_apply: Every lip-sync PROMPT.txt carries a 'VO SPEAKER: <character_id>' line. The render pipeline resolves that id against this file to pick the Kling voice. If character_id is not in this file, render fails with a clear error — force the operator to canonise the voice before rendering.
_meta.when_to_update: When the operator clones a new voice in Kling and wants to wire a NEW character. Set locked_at only after the first shipped episode using that voice.

bella.notes: Primary narrator across every episode. 25-year-old NYC-born Irish-Italian woman, international (Melbourne home base). ElevenLabs canonical voice per Master Bible v2 §1 — supersedes the old M7ya1YbaeFaPXljg9BpK. ⚠ Confirm once against the live ElevenLabs voice, then never change. Pitch/speed sliders unchanged from the 2026-04-20 calibration.

ciao.notes: Italian Greyhound internal monologue. Rendered via Bella's voice with pitch_shift +2 semitones + dry, wry read. Alternative: a distinct Kling voice trained as Ciao — set voice_id directly and pitch_shift to 0.

danny.notes: Mid-40s Australian-Italian gastropub owner (The Copper Fox, Soho, London). Warm, energetic, a little London-cheeky. Voice must stay consistent across all Danny episodes.

her_walk_in.notes: Day 2 Story 02 — generic warm walk-in customer (late 50s, Italian-Australian, discovering the pub via Google Maps). Not a canonised ally; voice can be reused for unnamed walk-ins in later episodes.

enzo_maria.notes: Compound id for Enzo + Maria (La Grotta, Carlton). Enzo speaks on camera; Maria is usually a silent presence through the pass. If Maria needs dialogue later, split into separate 'enzo' and 'maria' entries.

sophie.notes: Reserved Melbourne fine-dining operator (Wren, South Yarra). Measured, unhurried, slightly slower voice_speed reinforces composure. Pairs with quiet warmth — when she talks about food, everything stops. Single parent — Mia (5) has visual presence only.

arun_priya.notes: Compound id for Arun + Priya (The Ember Room, Shoreditch, London). Arun speaks on camera (talks fast, worries out loud); Priya is the anchor. If Priya needs dialogue later, split into separate 'arun' and 'priya' entries below.

arun.notes: Standalone Arun voice when split from arun_priya. Fast-talking, worries out loud, British-Indian London accent. Slightly higher voice_speed reinforces the anxious-energy signal.

priya.notes: Standalone Priya voice when split from arun_priya. Calm, precise, the anchor. Slightly slower voice_speed reinforces steady-energy signal. British-Indian London accent.

frank.notes: Ally tied to enzo_maria. Quiet, measured, unhurried retired-librarian energy. Slightly slower voice_speed reinforces the 'never performs' register from allies.json.

diane.notes: Ally tied to enzo_maria. Warm, unhurried, softly audible over service noise — retired English teacher.

tunde.notes: Tunde — Lagos Fire (Nigerian), Peckham, London. ElevenLabs voice chosen 2026-04-24 pending Kling clone. Warm, positive, supportive per the 2026-04-23 personality pivot.

haeun.notes: Ha-eun — Soyeon (Korean), Koreatown, Los Angeles. ElevenLabs voice chosen 2026-04-24 pending Kling clone. Warm, positive, supportive per the 2026-04-23 personality pivot.

mei.notes: Mei — Golden Plum (Cantonese), Chinatown, Sydney. ElevenLabs voice chosen 2026-04-24 pending Kling clone. Warm, positive, supportive per the 2026-04-23 personality pivot.
